playlist.title: AI in 60 Minutes — Free AI Course for Beginners (India)
playlist.description: A free, beginner-friendly AI course in 6 short lessons. Learn what ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude really are, set them up safely, write useful prompts, protect your data and build a daily AI habit. Practical examples for Indian learners: students, working professionals, homemakers, career returners and small business owners. Take the full course with exercises and a free certificate at https://lmapacademy.org/courses/ai-in-60-minutes/

videos.title: What is ChatGPT, Really? AI Explained Simply for Beginners | Lesson 1
videos.hook: ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude explained in plain English: how they actually work, what they're brilliant at, and where they confidently get things wrong.

videos.title: How to Create a Free ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude Account Safely | Lesson 2
videos.hook: Sign up for a free AI assistant the right way: official apps only, an email you control, and the privacy settings to check before you type anything personal.

videos.title: 5 ChatGPT Prompts That Save Hours Every Week (Copy & Use) | Lesson 3
videos.hook: Five everyday prompts you can copy today: write an email, summarise a long document, explain anything simply, plan your week and rewrite messages professionally.

videos.title: Simple Prompt Formula for Better ChatGPT Answers | Lesson 4
videos.hook: Stop getting generic AI answers. One four-line formula (role, task, context, format) with real examples from a job seeker, a career returner and a Class 12 student.

videos.title: Never Paste THIS into ChatGPT + How to Fact-Check AI Answers | Lesson 5
videos.hook: Six things you should never share with an AI assistant, how to anonymise before you paste, and a simple routine to catch AI hallucinations before they cost you.

videos.title: Use AI Every Day: A Simple 7-Day Plan for Beginners | Lesson 6
videos.hook: A day-by-day plan to make AI part of your routine in one week, five tips to make it stick, and where to go next once the basics click.
